title: Hot inland, cool on the coast
text: San Luis Obispo County runs from a cool, damp northern coast to a hot, dry interior. For much of the summer, the Santa Lucia and Garcia ranges keep the ocean air on the coast, apart from the drier interior. At the Paso Robles airport, inland, July afternoons average a high of about 93 degrees, while at the San Luis Obispo County Regional Airport, nearer the sea, the July average high is about 78. January nights at Paso Robles average a low of about 35 degrees, and the normal snowfall there is zero.

s1.title: San Luis Obispo County, California
s1.quote: Conditions range from a cool, damp northern coast to a hot, dry interior, including the Cuyama Valley. The Garcia and Santa Lucia ranges intercept Pacific rain-bearing clouds and separate coastal marine air from the drier interior during much of summer.
